description: Représentation spatiale des différents points d'eau par région du Sénégal is a data set listed in Africa GeoPortal (Esri), a continental ArcGIS Hub, published or maintained by Africa GeoPortal. Cette carte représente l'ensemble des lieux naturels ou structures artificielles contenant de l'eau pour alimenter la consommation humaine ou animale dans chaque département du Sénégal Elle donne l'emplacement spatiale des zones d'eau dans chaque département comprenant des puits, des équipements de construction élevée, des forages ainsi que les autres points d'eau. Coverage: Senegal. The portal files it under the publisher Africa GeoPortal. Its tags are Points, eau, Sénégal, Régions, lieux. The portal shows 2020-02-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom rights statement written on the portal listing (long text, see the linked page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water supply and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record platform-africa-geoportal-esri.
